items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She went for that occasion to Teddy Kennedy’s house for that dedication and the reception.

ctx.x: No, she just said, no I don’t like him, I’m not going. We had been to the opening of the Kennedy Center because we were founding artists there, and I’ve been looking for the last thirty years trying to find out where our names are inscribed. It’s supposed to be somewhere in the Kennedy Center as founding artists, but I haven’t been able to find it. She went for that occasion to Teddy Kennedy’s house for that dedication and the reception. She went to Bill Clinton, President Clinton, invited us to play at the…
You played for the king of Morocco?
